description: Create a new Security Playbook in OneUptime. Returns the created Security Playbook object with its ID. Use this to add new Security Playbooks to your project. Note: projectId is inferred from your API key — you do not need to provide it.

description.description: When to use the playbook and what it is for.
description.example: This is an example of longer text content that might be stored in this field.

detectionRuleIds.description: Run only on cases with a detection from one of these detection rules. Empty runs on cases from any rule.

detectionSource.description: Run only on cases raised by this source: a Detection Rule, Threat Intel, a Connected Product or Entity Risk. Empty runs on every source.

isEnabled.description: Whether the playbook runs on its own. A disabled playbook can still be run by hand from a case.

minimumSecurityCasePriorityId.description: ID of the lowest case priority the playbook runs on by itself. Empty runs on every priority.

name.description: What the playbook does, in a few words.

projectId.description: ID of the project this playbook belongs to.

steps.description: The steps the playbook takes, in order. Each has an action, its settings, and whether it needs approval, may fail without stopping the run, or runs only when threat intel matched.

trigger.description: When the playbook runs on its own: Case Opened, Detection Added (a new detection joins an open case), or Manual (only when somebody runs it).

name: create_security_playbook
title: Create Security Playbook
